summary: The customer called Apex Telecom reporting a two-hour home internet outage while working from home. The agent identified an unplanned fiber optic line cut nearby, informed the customer that field technicians were already on-site, provided an estimated restoration time, and applied a free 15-gigabyte mobile data pass to compensate for the inconvenience. The call ended satisfactorily with the customer thanking the agent.

evidence.text: I would be happy to apply a 15-gigabyte temporary data pass to your mobile account free of charge right now so you can use your hotspot without worrying.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Apply a free 15GB temporary data pass to the customer's mobile account.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was exceptionally polite, professional, and composed throughout the call.

evidence.text: I am very sorry to hear that your internet is down, especially during your workday. I understand how stressful that can be.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent demonstrated sincere and prompt empathy regarding the customer's stressful remote work situation.

evidence.text: The current estimated time for full restoration is about forty-five minutes to an hour. They are making good progress.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully diagnosed the regional outage, provided accurate timelines, and proactively offered a temporary data pass.

evidence.text: No, your router hardware actually looks healthy. Let me check our regional network status board for 742 Evergreen Terrace.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained technical findings and next steps in a clear and easily understandable manner.

evidence.text: Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly checked for additional needs, summarized resolution, and provided a professional closing.

evidence.text: As a matter of fact, yes! There is an unplanned fiber optic line cut about three blocks away from your home
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately pulled account details, checked regional network statuses, and applied the promised data pass correctly.

evidence.text: May I please have your account number or the phone number associated with your service to pull up your file?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed standard verification protocols before accessing customer account details.

quote.text: Hi Marcus. Look, my home internet has been down for the last two hours, and I am getting really frustrated because I work from home and I am missing important meetings.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Okay, fine. Please make it quick though, my boss is messaging me on my phone asking why I am offline.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Please tell me there is an outage and it is not just me.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: I just got the text. Wow, okay, that is actually really helpful of you, Marcus.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Alright. Well, I am still not thrilled about the outage, but I really appreciate you sorting this out quickly and giving me that extra data.
